headline: A political advertisement is putting Colorado's AI disclosure law to the test, according to a 9News report.
score_reason: Lowered from 5: the 9News video report could not be read, so the claim and its detail are unverified.
importance_line: Colorado voters and candidates are affected by how the state's AI disclosure rules for political ads are enforced, but the details of the ad and of any complaint are not known.
summary: 9News reports that a political advertisement is testing Colorado's AI disclosure law.
notes: 9News video page (HTTP 403) and the related 9News article 'Colorado law to stop AI deepfakes from swaying elections will be tested after the election' (403) not readable; no other outlet found for the same story.
